influences.name: Kendrick Lamar
influences.context: He could pull ideas out of me, and could actually stretch the boundaries of what I would normally produce... Kendrick really pushed me past the point of like "this is what you do" and "this is how you do it", so to speak.

influences.name: Flying Lotus
influences.context: With Flying Lotus, you gotta be really straightforward with your music, where it has to be honest and 'you'.

influences.name: Jimmy Cobb
influences.context: He would be listening to Jimmy Cobb and Vinnie Colaiuta. And he would be putting on Zildjian Drum Day tapes.

influences.name: Louis Cole
influences.context: Louis continues to inspire me because he's just one of those people that just ... he's built different. Again, [he's] built different and his creative process is specific to him.

influences.name: Richard Pryor
influences.context: I'm one of those kids from the Richard Pryor school, so to speak.

influences.name: Reggie Andrews
influences.context: Some of my biggest influencers… I'll give you two, actually my father (Ronald Bruner Sr.) and my high school music teacher, Reggie Andrews. To this day, and I've been out of high school for a while, I didn't realize how much my music teacher influenced me.

influences.name: George Duke
influences.context: I saw this picture, this is like years later, of my music teacher playing in George Duke and Patrice Rushen staying around him, watching him play.
